methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from official vendor pricing pages on 2026-06-15. All plans are per-screen subscriptions unless noted. NoviSign publishes its $18/$26/$44 prices as annual-billing rates (save 10%) and explicitly publishes month-to-month rates of $20/$29/$49; monthlyUsd records the annual-billing rate and annualDiscountPct is set to 10 to match the stated savings. OptiSigns explicitly publishes both monthly and annual rates, enabling exact annualDiscountPct (~10%). Yodeck lists $8/$11/$15/screen/month as its standard pricing (billed annually); no separate month-to-month price was found on the pricing page so monthlyUsd reflects the published per-screen rate and annualDiscountPct is set to null. Rise Vision lists $11/$13 as month-to-month rates with 9%/12% stated savings on annual — annualized effective monthly rates are $10.01 and $11.44 respectively; monthlyUsd records the listed month-to-month price to avoid computed guesses, and annualDiscountPct records the stated percentage. ScreenCloud's annual rate was not disclosed on the pricing page (annual toggle exists but no price rendered); monthlyUsd records the published month-to-month rates. Kitcast annual prices ($7/$10/screen) are explicitly published giving computable discounts (22% and 29%). G2 returned HTTP 403; Capterra confirmed Yodeck/ScreenCloud/OptiSigns/Rise Vision/NoviSign starting prices as corroboration. hipaa/baa/bilingual fields are null unless explicitly stated on vendor pages. minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overagePerMin/overagePerCall = null on all plans (non-telephony vertical).

vendors.name: Yodeck
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page yodeck.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Capterra listing confirmed starting price at $8/mo.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Single screen forever free. 30-day trial gives full feature access on up to 5 screens.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Per screen, billed annually. Includes all media types, 80+ apps/integrations, 500+ templates, playlists, screen scheduling, multi-zone layouts, Canva integration. Free 1GB Raspberry Pi 4 player with annual plan. No separate month-to-month rate published.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per screen, billed annually. Adds Microsoft apps, Power BI/Grafana/Tableau dashboards, tag-based playlists, playback reports, API access. Free 4GB Raspberry Pi 4 player with annual plan.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Per screen, billed annually. Adds workspaces/hierarchies, billing entities, branded templates, custom user roles, SSO via SAML, player lockdown/encryption, audit logs. Free 4GB Raspberry Pi 4 player.

plans.name: Enterprise+
plans.notes: Contact sales. Customized onboarding, 1-hour SLA with phone support, dedicated account manager, professional design services, quarterly business reviews.

vendors.name: ScreenCloud
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page screencloud.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Annual toggle exists but annual per-screen rate not rendered in page content; monthly rates recorded. Capterra confirmed $20/mo starting price.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per screen/month. 80+ apps and integrations, unlimited file storage, design templates, Quick Post. Annual billing available but exact rate not published on pricing page. Price shown is month-to-month rate (+ VAT outside US).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per screen/month. All Core features plus premium apps/integrations, dashboard displays, QR code metrics. Annual billing available but exact rate not published on pricing page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. All Pro features plus professional design support, onboarding, and training. Free device included on annual plans.

vendors.name: OptiSigns
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page optisigns.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Both monthly and annual rates explicitly published enabling exact annualDiscountPct calculation.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free. Up to 3 supported screen types, 1GB storage, 25 basic apps.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Per screen. Annual rate $9/screen/month; month-to-month $10/screen/month. Playlists, 100+ integrations, templates, feeds.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per screen. Annual rate $11.25/screen/month; month-to-month $12.50/screen/month. Adds advanced roles, folder security, approval workflows, proof of play.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: Per screen. Annual rate $13.50/screen/month; month-to-month $15/screen/month. Adds Microsoft 365, Power BI/Salesforce dashboards, OptiSync dynamic data mapping, auto power on/off. Marked most popular.

plans.name: Engage
plans.notes: Per screen. Annual rate $27/screen/month; month-to-month $30/screen/month. Interactive kiosk designer, lift and learn, check-in apps, QR interactions, event analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Per screen. Annual rate $40.50/screen/month; month-to-month $45/screen/month. Minimum 25 screens. Dedicated customer success manager, priority support, GraphQL API, PaaS access.

vendors.name: Rise Vision
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page risevision.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15 (two fetches: K-12 and Business/Government segments). Listed month-to-month prices with stated annual savings percentages. Business and K-12/Higher Ed share the same $11/$13 per-display rates.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Per display/month, month-to-month rate. Annual billing saves 9% (~$10.01/display/month). 750+ animated templates, unlimited content storage, unlimited users, scheduling and playlists, offline playback. Applies across K-12, Higher Ed, and Business/Government segments.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per display/month, month-to-month rate. Annual billing saves 12% (~$11.44/display/month). Adds CAP emergency alerts, Google/Microsoft integrations, Meta integration, stock media library, brand settings.

plans.name: Enterprise (per display)
plans.notes: Annual only: $164/display/year ($13.67/display/month equivalent). Unlimited displays, teacher/district roles, classroom alerts, screen sharing, content approval workflow, SSO via SAML. Billed as lump-sum annually.

plans.name: Enterprise (per school)
plans.notes: Annual only: $1,399/school/year ($116.58/month equivalent) for unlimited displays per school. Same features as per-display Enterprise. Best value for schools with 10+ displays.

vendors.name: NoviSign
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page novisign.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Published annual-billing rates ($18/$26/$44) and explicit month-to-month rates ($20/$29/$49) both shown on page. monthlyUsd records the annual-billing rate (lowest published committed price) and annualDiscountPct=10 matches the stated savings.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per screen. Published annual rate: $18/screen/month (billed annually). Month-to-month rate $20/screen/month. 50+ widgets, 500+ templates, scheduling, RSS, offline capability, remote monitoring. Free setup assistance included.

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.notes: Per screen. Published annual rate: $26/screen/month (billed annually). Month-to-month rate $29/screen/month. Adds Zapier (5,000+ apps), Toast POS, AI image creator, Power BI/Tableau, video wall editor, IoT/RFID triggers. Marked best value.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per screen. Published annual rate: $44/screen/month (billed annually). Month-to-month rate $49/screen/month. Adds admin management, SSO, API access, content approval workflows, brand kit profiles, audit logs.

plans.name: Partners
plans.notes: Contact sales. Minimum 20 screens. 100% white-label instance, full management console, wholesale pricing model. Annual billing only.

vendors.name: Kitcast

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per screen. Annual rate $10/screen/month ($120/screen/year); month-to-month $14/screen/month. Adds advanced permissions, Power BI/Tableau dashboards, web pages, live streaming, SSO/SAML, Microsoft 365, emergency alerts, API access, MDM, zero-touch deployment, audit logs. Marked most popular.

plans.name: Enterprise
